body:
I don't think we should use the `Promise` machinery here. The other specifications that provide steps for parsing a blocklist don't do this. I'm guessing you wanted to be able to link to the [fetch](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch) algorithm but I don't think that algorithm is appropriate because we're not fetching the resource on behalf of a document.

The use of a `Promise` here also makes the definition of "USB blocklist" a little ambiguous because it somewhat implies that the steps referring to the blocklist could block on fetching the list, which really isn't the intent here.
Removed `Promise` and fetch, please take another look

Let |components| be the result of [=strictly splitting=] |line| starting from the beginning of |line| on code point ':'. 1. If the [=list/size=] of |components| is 3, set |bcdDevice| to the result of interpreting |components|[2] as a hexadecimal number. 1. [=list/Append=] a new {{USBBlocklistEntry}} with |idVendor|, |idProduct|, and |bcdDevice| to |blocklist|. ```
